article.en: Last week at a dinner party, the hostess asked me to sit next to Mrs Rumbold.
article.zh: 上周的一次宴会上，女主人安排我坐在兰伯尔德夫人的身旁。

article.en: Mrs Rumbold was a large, unsmiling lady in a tight black dress.
article.zh: 兰伯尔德夫人是个身材高大、表情严肃的女人，穿一件紧身的黑衣服。

article.en: She did not even look up when I took my seat beside her.
article.zh: 我在她旁边坐下时，她甚至连头都没抬一下。

article.en: Her eyes were fixed on her plate and in a short time, she was busy eating.
article.zh: 她的眼睛盯着盘子，不一会儿就忙着吃了起来。
我试图找些话题和她聊聊。

article.en: 'A new play is coming to the Globe soon,' I said. 'Will you be seeing it?'
article.zh: “一出新剧很快就要在环球剧院上演了，”我说，“您会去看吗？”

article.en: In despair, I asked her whether she was enjoying her dinner.
article.zh: 绝望之中，我问她饭菜是否合她的口味。

article.en: 'Young man,' she answered, 'if you ate more and talked less, we would both enjoy our dinner!'
article.zh: “年轻人，”她回答说，“如果你多吃点，少说点，我们俩就都会吃得好的！”
